verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll documents running payroll with same-day or next-day deadlines and letting users review and approve payroll before paychecks are sent. It also documents timesheet approval that syncs to QuickBooks and Payroll AI that collects time data and flags inconsistencies. However, the evidence is marketing-level: the review-approve claim is stated in the context of auto payroll for salaried employees, and nothing describes a single guided run flow. Missing for 10: explicit preview of payroll totals (gross/net, taxes) before submission, documentation of a single end-to-end run flow combining hours review, earnings review and submit, coverage for hourly employees in the review step, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
